vulnerability.name: USN-9002-1
vulnerability.description: It was discovered that the io_uring subsystem in the Linux kernel did not properly handle canceled task work when processing certain wait operations, leading to the operation being performed in the wrong task context. A local attacker could possibly use this to cause a denial of service (system crash). (CVE-2026-81010)  Several security issues were discovered in the Linux kernel. An attacker could possibly use these to compromise the system.
